changes.text: OmniVTLA: added. Vision-tactile-language-action policy (IEEE RA-L, arXiv 2508.08706) on Paxini Gen2 Hall-array touch, run on a UR5 with a jaw gripper or an 11-sensor four-finger hand (100% pick-and-place on the hand); code announced as coming soon, no weights.

TAVI: added. See to Touch (arXiv 2309.12300) trains Allegro hand policies with online RL on 15 XELA uSkin pads through the T-Dex tactile encoder, rewarded by visual matching to one demonstration; 73% over 6 tasks; code on GitHub, no policy weights.

UniTacHand: added. Aligns a 137-taxel pressure glove and a 1,062-taxel Inspire tactile hand on the MANO UV map with contrastive learning on 10 min of paired data (arXiv 2512.21233); 73.3% one-shot success; repository holds only the project page.
